Fig. 12. Counterfactual degradation transfer for answering Q1. The degradation feature D1, extracted from a distorted image before the causal layer, is combined with another reference image to examine whether the learned degradation representation is independent of image content.

Fig. 13. Controlled validation of visual masking for answering Q2. The raw degradation feature and the modulated degradation feature are compared on the TID2013 gaussian blur and noise subsets. The evaluation includes overall quality prediction, fixed-level cross-content ranking, reference sensitivity alignment, and per-level pairwise accuracy.
